rule: **Existing tools work.** Type checkers work through `.d.vibe.ts` (VIP-27), and linters, Knip, bundlers and test runners each read `.vibe`.
errorPattern: consumer types differ from the \.ts twin[\s\S]*=> any
reason: A .ts module's declaration of a type it infers from a .vibe import is any (export declare const layer: (port: number) => any), where the .ts twin's names System.
